name: email-validator
// packageManager: pinned so Vercel and Render resolve the same pnpm through corepack rather than guessing
// engines: the worker runs its .ts files through Node's own type stripping, which is on by default from 22.18

scripts.build: node api.js && tsc -b packages/core packages/db packages/pipeline packages/storage
scripts.// build:web: what Vercel runs — the app imports the packages' built output, so they have to exist first
scripts.// typecheck: packages are project references, so their declarations must exist before dependents can be checked
scripts.// dev: web alone only accepts uploads — nothing processes a job without the worker, hence both, in parallel
